admins_disabled_at_check.name: admins_disabled_at_check
admins_disabled_at_check.value: (status = 'DISABLED' AND disabled_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'DISABLED' AND disabled_at IS NULL)

notification_delivery_attempts_error_che.name: notification_delivery_attempts_error_check
notification_delivery_attempts_error_che.value: (outcome = 'SUCCEEDED' AND error_code IS NULL) OR (outcome <> 'SUCCEEDED' AND error_code IS NOT NULL)

notifications_completed_check.name: notifications_completed_check
notifications_completed_check.value: (status = 'PENDING' AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status <> 'PENDING' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

operational_events_resolution_check.name: operational_events_resolution_check
operational_events_resolution_check.value: resolved_by_event_id IS NULL OR resolved_at IS NOT NULL

template_revisions_body_check.name: template_revisions_body_check
template_revisions_body_check.value: (action = 'SET' AND body IS NOT NULL AND length(body) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096) OR (action = 'REVERT' AND body IS NULL)

tenants_parent_check.name: tenants_parent_check
tenants_parent_check.value: (kind = 'PRIMARY' AND parent_tenant_id IS NULL) OR (kind <> 'PRIMARY' AND parent_tenant_id IS NOT NULL)
